meta.name: Love And Affairs
meta.description:
A marriage becomes a battlefield of love and doubt. Betrayal - or just suspicion?

Complete series. On your server: S1 5/5

videos.title: Love
videos.overview: At Abhijit’s birthday party everyone is happy amidst the celebrations. But what seems to be bothering Roshni?

videos.title: Affair
videos.overview: Roshni keeps her feelings of anguish hidden and acts like everything is normal. How long will she manage to keep it together?

videos.title: Broken
videos.overview: Roshni is at her wit's end, tired of hiding her feelings. What will happen when she finally confronts her drunk husband?

videos.title: Possess
videos.overview: The conversation between Abhijit and Roshni gets heated up, and a bitter truth is revealed. How will Abhijit react?

videos.title: Confessions
videos.overview: As reality hits Abhijit and Roshni, their relationship changes overnight. Will they part ways - or will their love emerge a winner?
